dependencies.required_evidence: A repeated raw-first scope manifest binds canonical raw, transformed byte, coder-decision, entry-state, mapping, and economic identities.
Independent source audit freezes post-WRT template names, explicit keys, positional indices, field boundaries, depth, overflow, mismatch, and sleep semantics.

contract.role: shared zero-credit causal population tape for Schema, PDA, Fiber-CTS, Fiber-FOSSIL, and conditional LOOM analysis

record_abi.event_type_encoding: uint8 ordinal in the frozen event_types array; any other value is invalid
record_abi.key_identity: 0 none, 1 explicit key, 2 positional index; every other value is invalid
record_abi.coordinate_rule: For a byte event, physical_coder_decision_coordinate is the first of its eight binary decisions.

descriptor_sidecar.purpose: offline alias and parser-drift verification only
descriptor_sidecar.content: sorted length-delimited canonical descriptors keyed by the 128-bit witness digest
descriptor_sidecar.causal_exclusion: No shadow or native predictor may query the global sidecar; it would expose descriptors before their first decoded occurrence.
descriptor_sidecar.alias_rule: Any equal digest with unequal canonical descriptor bytes invalidates the complete tape receipt.

build_protocol: Build A and Build B run in fresh processes from the same source-bound scope and parser.
Each build replays the reversible frontend from canonical raw byte zero and emits records only when their fields are decoder-visible at that coordinate.
Tape, descriptor sidecar, summary, record count, coordinate ranges, event counts, flags, route counts, and rolling digests are content-addressed.
A and B must be byte-identical for tape, sidecar, and summary and must contain zero descriptor aliases.
The tape is immutable after verification and each consumer binds its exact SHA-256.
contract.consumer_rule: A shadow may reveal each record only at its physical coder coordinate and may read only fields already available to the causal parser. Truth bytes and future entry/exit records remain inaccessible until their coordinates. Final codecs must parse causally themselves and may not package this tape.

activation_requirements: q1 qualifies, q1 economics activates, the raw-first scope is verified, and the exclusive full-1G lease is absent.
The parser source, record ABI, event enumeration, flags, descriptor hash, sidecar law, commands, outputs, guards, and schemas are frozen before Build A.
Two independent guarded builds and an independent verifier pass byte identity, coordinate, causality, alias, output-closure, and resource checks.
Every later Schema/PDA/Fiber/LOOM shadow binds one tape hash and may not reinterpret fields.
claim_boundary: The tape is zero-credit scientific population infrastructure and is forbidden from the final counted codec package.
Repeated tape identity proves parser and coordinate consistency, not predictive value.
No tape, parser count, route count, or event count is an archive saving or Hutter Prize proof.
